codeReview.summary: The implementation successfully updates iSH.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj to add all 11 new Instrumentation framework files to the correct target (libiSHApp). The worker correctly identified that trace_config.c was never in the Xcode project build (it was only built via Meson), so no removal was needed. All file references are correctly typed (sourcecode.swift for Swift files, sourcecode.cpp.objcpp for the Objective-C++ bridge). Swift 5.0 build settings and LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS were added to both libiSHApp and iSH targets. The project builds successfully with '** BUILD SUCCEEDED **'.
